title: Metroid × Pokémon: Wilds
save_policy: fresh independent fork progress; full emulator checkpoints preserve Pokémon party and defeated-actor ledger; vanilla MZM SRAM does not persist bridge state

parent_games.role: extracted native combat code, tables and sprite assets

design_choices.label: Side-view world
design_choices.implementation: Retain actual room rendering, collision, camera, HUD and world source

design_choices.label: Metroid movement
design_choices.implementation: Retain native Samus code and all campaign equipment behaviors

design_choices.label: Explore and unlock
design_choices.implementation: Retain entire campaign, native equipment gates, bosses, maps and save system

design_choices.label: Your party versus one wild
design_choices.implementation: One species-matched opponent from actual source actor contact; extracted Emerald damage/type data plus reduced singles turn bridge
design_choices.fidelity: adapted subset; full AI bytecode interpreter and trainer item policy are not ported

design_choices.label: Area changes the matchup
design_choices.implementation: Map current MZM area modulo three to clear/rain/sun; extracted Emerald damage calculation reads native weather bits
design_choices.fidelity: new cross-game mapping; Emerald overworld weather renderer is not ported

design_choices.label: Zebes campaign
design_choices.implementation: Retain actual story, rooms, assets and campaign structure

design_choices.label: Three Pokémon party
design_choices.implementation: Bulbasaur, Charmander and Squirtle form the persistent player party; HP, PP, status and selected active member survive encounters; full-party defeat restores party at an energy cost

design_choices.label: Pokémon field creatures
design_choices.implementation: Safe mapped native ordinary actors draw Paras, Geodude, Zigzagoon, Zubat or Wingull using extracted Pokémon indexed pixels; source Metroid AI/hitboxes retained

dependency_decisions.resolution: Original pause resource backup and world reload path; native Mode3 during combat; original OBJ allocation replaced only if it is not shared with an unmapped/different-species actor or overlapping earlier allocation
Real native hitbox contact with an eligible rendered Pokémon actor only. No SELECT entry or health-loss trigger. Frozen actors keep original solid collision behavior.

Victory resolves the exact area/room/roomSlot/nativeId identity through source SpriteUtilSpriteDeath and rewards8Samus energy. Ledger suppresses defeated actor on reload without duplicate drops. Retreat keeps it alive. Full-party KO restores party and halves nontrivial Samus energy.180gameplay-frame contact cooldown.
Zoomer yellow/red→Paras; Zeela→Geodude; red Zeela→Zigzagoon; Ripper brown/purple→Zubat; Waver/unused Waver→Wingull. Bosses, story actors and shared dependent enemy graphics remain native.

Wingull/Zigzagoon use Emerald overworld frames. Zubat/Geodude/Paras use actual Emerald battle-front frames adapted to32px field art, identified in extraction provenance. All battle art remains original64px source art.
Party and128-entry bounded defeated-identity ledger live in native IWRAM and full browser checkpoints. No vanilla SRAM bridge extension; ledger evicts oldest only after128unique wins.
Reviewed singles/no held items/no badge states; reduced damage-scoring AI. Full Emerald scripts, capture/evolution and broad effects remain unsupported.
Whole source campaign is retained. Later human clarification selects side-view Metroid movement and Pokémon combat; old toy-grid bounds do not truncate world.

unsupported: Arbitrary bundles are not automatically linkable
Complete Emerald runtime/AI scripts, held items, capture, evolution
Pokémon conversion for every enemy/boss/story actor
